results.title: AngelFish
results.overview: Max searches for his perfect match, his white whale, his AngelFish.

results.title: Hobocop
results.overview: HOBOCOP takes viewers back to the gritty streets of 1999, where Bob Glazier's iconic character, Buddy Ross, emerges from the shadows. Part Hobo, Part Cop, All Man.

results.title: The Relic
results.overview: A grieving mother begins to believe that her dead son is trying to contact her. She arranges a seance that accidentally unleashes evil forces into her home.

results.title: The Ox Road
results.overview: Prince Joachim and author Steffen Jacobsen are on a hike through Jutland, bringing with them their own life stories. A beautiful nature film with a words of wisdom along the way.

results.title: Black Krampus
results.overview: Six estranged friends reunite over Christmas, only to accidentally awaken Black Krampus-a darker, older incarnation of the yuletide demon long erased from African folklore. As the creature stalks them one by one, punishing past sins with brutal precision, the group must unravel the legend's buried truth before their names are etched onto his eternal naughty list.

results.title: Sky Force
results.overview: In the 1965 Indo-Pak War, India faces a devastating surprise attack. Wing Commander Ahuja leads a retaliatory strike, but Squadron Leader Vijaya goes missing after a heroic solo engagement against a superior enemy jet. Ahuja spends 23 years seeking the truth and uncovering a cover-up.

results.title: Shanghai Wonton
results.overview: The film tells the story of a retired father who comes to the park's dating corner to find a marriage partner for his son, but inadvertently gets involved in an emotional whirlpool.

results.title: Caribou - Zénith Paris - La Villette
results.overview: Canadian producer Dan Snaith brings his Caribou project to the Paris Zénith on an exploration of his entire discography, combining the big tunes of the past with sweet treats from his latest album Honey.

results.title: The Idea
results.overview: A bored couple's fascination with spying on their younger neighbors blurs the line between curiosity and intrusion.

results.title: The Gospel of Revolution
results.overview: The revolutions that swept Latin America in the second half of the 20th century owe much to the participation of millions of Christians who engaged in political struggles in the name of their faith, paying a heavy toll for undermining the traditional relationship between the Church and power. Driven by Liberation theology, they challenged military regimes and oligarchies, risking their lives. Far from Marx's idea of religion as 'opium of the people', here the people fought for the advent of the Kingdom of God on Earth, rather than in Heaven.

results.title: NXT vs. TNA Showdown
results.overview: NXT vs. TNA Showdown was a professional wrestling television special co-produced by WWE and partner promotion TNA. The event took place on Tuesday, October 7, 2025, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida and aired live as a special episode of NXT on The CW.

results.title: Tugan Batyr
results.overview: Tugan Batyr is a smart, kind, and brave boy. Thanks to his big and kind heart, he was given the magical Ring Zikhgir, which contains the power to defeat the evil wizard Sarykan-as decreed by the wise wizard and teacher Alim Babai. Inquisitive and courageous, Tugan Batyr defends his homeland from the forces of evil, using not only strength and ingenuity but also magical artifacts, which, not by chance, he came into possession of.

results.title: Game Changer
results.overview: Ram, a newly appointed district collector, takes charge in a city in Andhra Pradesh and immediately confronts the deeply entrenched corruption and inefficiency plaguing the government. Determined to bring reforms, he initiates sweeping changes, sparking a fierce conflict with a powerful state Minister.

results.title: Deep Inside: Angeli Khang
results.overview: Hosted by Ataska, VMX fans will surely be delighted with to this treat as we dig deeper to the Queen of VMX, Angeli Khang's most iconic and steamiest scenes.

results.title: Muir Beach
results.overview: A previously unknown short by Gunvor Nelson, discovered in 2023 along with approximately 150 rolls of film in her apartment.

results.title: The Adventures of Nexus VI
results.overview: The crew of the spaceship "NEXUS VI" has crash-landed on a wild planet after an epic space battle. Shaken by the co-pilot's abduction by a mysterious cult, they will face countless trials in their quest to rescue him.

results.title: Echter Mann
results.overview: Samuel struggles with depression. To hide his vulnerability, he feigns a happy life. But when his friend Marvin advises him to seek professional help, this leads to a decision that allows him to lead a normal life again.

results.title: Museum of the Night
results.overview: At the end of the 1960s, Argentine artist Leandro Katz participated in “Theatre of the Ridiculous”, an eccentric group linked to New York’s queer underground. This film-essay moves between archives, testimonies, and spectres of the past that question the present. Photography, film, video, and sound intertwine to approach, if only in brief flashes, that mythical past and raise questions about time, art, sexuality, death, and cinema.

results.title: Sheep
results.overview: In the lush fields of northern Belgium, as winter tightens its grip, the sheep of Eddy, Jeroen, and Johny become silent witnesses of a hidden drama when a wolf is driven to the edges of human lands in search of sustenance.  With the three human protagonists doing anything within their power to patronize their rights of existence, this film stands up for the least heard voice in Belgium’s brand new wolf territory: that of the bleating sheep.
